name: Wan 2.1
tagline: Open-source text-to-video and image-to-video model for consumer GPUs
real_test_summary: Rendered a 5-second 480p clip using the 1.3B FP8 checkpoint on an RTX 3060 12GB in 48s via ComfyUI.
cons: No native Apple Silicon MPS acceleration
install_command: git clone https://github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.1.git && pip install -r requirements.txt
description: Open-source video foundation model supporting text-to-video and image-to-video generation with quantized 1.3B and 14B checkpoints runnable on consumer NVIDIA GPUs.
